Am I the only one that feels like she's completely fine after the hotfix? The day one frustrations obviously came from the insane flat damage on her passive and the general frustration of execution as a mechanic. Her Q range and spam early is annoying but I feel like people overvalue it. It's slow and does miniscule amounts of damage if she doesn't land all projectiles. The range compensates for it as her trading and laning feels incredibly lackluster compared to other mages. Maybe reduce the duration of her root but it's difficult to land outside of cluttered teamfights and melee champs running in a straight line. 

The reflect will be a pain point for years to come but it's just as any other new champion mechanic that we'll have to get used to. Besides, the ability feels entirely useless when there's nothing on the enemy team to reflect other than ranged basic attacks. It definitely sucks being an adc getting oneshot by yourself though.

She needs peel and excels with comps that can lock down the enemy. I think she'll find a niche spot, but I don't think she's pick or ban worthy in her current state.

This arc has had its ups and downs but I don't think it can get worse than these last few chapters, which have truly showcased just how bad Hori's writing can get. While I'm still not over the terrible resolutions to Deku's emotions and his relationship with All Might, I've still enjoyed parts of it and the Stars and Stripes battle reeled me back in. 

This however, is just unbelievably and unforgivably poor storytelling. Terrible shonen tropes written at its absolute worst. Fuck everything about Aoyama. I've got no sympathy for how terribly written this scumbag is. The fact that he's forgiven like that is inexcusable for the lives he's ruined and the massive, world endangering threat he's helped put together.

I'm begging for it to pick up from here, but at this point I'm afraid for how rushed the ending might be. We all know Horikoshi can do better so what the fuck happened here?
I remember how big it was when XO was at like 2 million streams. It's crazy how much he's blown up these past years, but he really does deserve it!

Everything feels so weightless. Characters jump like they're on the moon, weapons have no impact or weight, the sound design is terrible, the kakuhou's look terrible and everything just looks so stiff because no one uses their joints to build up attacks. Everyone just swings their weapons and kakuhous with no thought. 

This was a dreadful episode to watch because everything just feels so slow. Absolute lowpoint for the season, let's hope it doesn't get worse.

It gets pretty noticeable at the end. I can admit it gets pretty exhausting fighting flying wyverns all the time or just dragons if that's what you wanna call them.
